title: Add test coverage for auth module edge cases
body:
## Test Coverage Improvements

### Summary
Added comprehensive test coverage for authentication edge cases that were previously untested.

### Changes
- Added tests for expired token handling in `tests/test_auth.py`
- Added tests for invalid token format detection
- Added tests for rate limiting on failed auth attempts

### Testing
- [x] All new tests pass
- [x] Coverage increased from 78% to 85%

This should help catch auth-related regressions early.

reviews.body: Great test coverage improvements! The edge cases you've identified are exactly what we needed.
